items.title: Happy 2027 Banner with Two Party Characters
items.alt: Two round confetti-covered party characters hold a gold-framed Happy 2027 banner with colorful balloon letters.
items.description: A party hat tops the banner while two smiling characters hang from its poles, wearing bright sneakers and scattered confetti dots.

items.title: January 2027 Calendar Page
items.alt: A red-topped tear-off calendar displays January in blue and 2027 in raised red numerals.
items.description: Metal rings hold a stack of cream pages beneath a stitched red binding; the month and year fill the front without a date grid.

items.title: Slanted Chrome and Blue 2027
items.alt: Forward-slanted 2027 numerals with silver chrome faces and deep blue extruded sides.
items.description: Sharp diagonal strokes and reflective chamfered edges give the wide number row a streamlined shape.

items.title: My 2027 Plans Clipboard
items.alt: A coral clipboard with a gold clip displays My 2027 Plans above four empty checkboxes and a teal pencil.
items.description: Four blank writing lines leave room for goals, while the large diagonal pencil overlaps the lower corner of the rounded clipboard.

items.title: Dream Big in 2027 Rocket Board
items.alt: A turquoise note reading Dream Big in 2027 is pinned to a wooden board beside a red rocket and smiling yellow star.
items.description: The rocket climbs through a compact white cloud along the board’s left edge, balancing the star at the upper right.

items.title: Memories of 2027 Keepsake Box
items.alt: An open embossed gold keepsake box holds blank photo cards and a red ribbon above a Memories of 2027 tag.
items.description: Cream quilted lining frames the upright cards, with a wide red bow draped across the ornate box and its hanging label.
